_: quickRS knob pack (P34.5 follow-up): see README.md. All px are app px at the 64 px master unless they say 'master px' (6x). Every sprite scales with the knob: canvas = 1.5 x knob size.

amp.scale_rule: every sprite is drawn at canvas = 1.5 x knob size (app px), centred on the knob centre (the sprite's centre = the rotation centre = knobs.rs's (cx, cy))
amp.radial_note: rows of r (fraction of the knob radius R = size/2) -> angle-mean outward normal (n_r, n_z), reflectance per channel m_rgb (coverage included), coverage, the body's mean colour over the Midnight panel; build a polar grid (64 segments) on these radii

indicator.canvas: a square centred on the knob centre, square_app_px_at_master x (size / 64) app px
indicator.rule: deg = -135 + 270 u; draw frame k = round((deg + 135) / 15) as a quad rotated by (deg - ANGLES[k]) about its centre
indicator.blend: normal (premultiplied over), drawn after the body's room layer

pedal.radial_note: rows of r (fraction of the knob radius R = size/2) -> angle-mean outward normal (n_r, n_z), reflectance per channel m_rgb (coverage included), coverage, the body's mean colour over the Midnight panel; build a polar grid (64 segments) on these radii

indicator.rule: deg = -135 + 270 u; draw frame k = round((deg + 135) / 15) as a quad rotated by (deg - ANGLES[k]) about its centre
indicator.blend: normal (premultiplied over), drawn after the body's room layer

vintage.radial_note: rows of r (fraction of the knob radius R = size/2) -> angle-mean outward normal (n_r, n_z), reflectance per channel m_rgb (coverage included), coverage, the body's mean colour over the Midnight panel; build a polar grid (64 segments) on these radii

indicator.rule: deg = -135 + 270 u; draw the frame k nearest deg (k = round((deg + 135) / 15)), as a quad rotated by (deg - ANGLES[k]) (|residual| <= 7.5 deg) about the canvas centre
indicator.blend: normal (premultiplied over), drawn after the body and its room layer
indicator.ptr_nm_note: the pointer at 0 deg: RGB = n*0.5+0.5, A = m; optional room layer that turns with it (rotate the vertex positions AND the normals' xy by deg)

chrome.radial_note: rows of r (fraction of the knob radius R = size/2) -> angle-mean outward normal (n_r, n_z), reflectance per channel m_rgb (coverage included), coverage, the body's mean colour over the Midnight panel; build a polar grid (64 segments) on these radii

indicator.canvas: a square centred on the knob centre, square_app_px_at_master x (size / 64) app px
indicator.rule: deg = -135 + 270 u; draw frame k = round((deg + 135) / 15) as a quad rotated by (deg - ANGLES[k]) about its centre
indicator.blend: normal (premultiplied over), drawn after the body's room layer

chrome.light: relit (round 2): silver base sRGB (214,216,220) = linear 0.67, anisotropic 0.97, roughness 0.25; key area light 110 W at elevation 30 deg (size 0.6), fill 10, no top strip, brighter dome 0.25 (tools/jobs_chrome3.json)

common.themes: dark themes only (t().dark); Daylight and classic keep knobs.rs as it is
common.rotation_centre: the sprite centre = knobs.rs (cx, cy) (whole pixels)
draw_order: indicator frame (normal over, rotated by the residual)
common.tick_geometry: unchanged from knobs.rs knob_px: n = 21 over 270 deg; r0 = size/2 + (5 if size < 50 else 8), r1 = size/2 + (9 or 14) app px; width 1.6 / 2.0; lit = accent + glow; home tick longer

room.method: assets/hall/README.md additive, per-channel m (m_rgb), at hall::LEVEL
room.mesh: polar grid, 64 segments, a feather ring at R + 0.5 px (m = 0) plus the radial rows' radii

common.resample: once per (style, size, ppp) on the CPU from the 576 px masters: premultiplied, area filter; rotate frames at master res before downsampling or rotate the quad (both fine)
common.light: key area light up-left (screen azimuth 135 deg, elevation 42), soft fill lower right, a top strip, dim dome with a horizon band
